paragraphs: Everyone who is 7 years or older and under 75 should observe fasting on Ekādaśī. Please avoid eating grains and beans on Ekādaśī. Complete fasting is considered most beneficial for those who are able.

When breaking the fast on Dvādaśī, the next day, please do so during the proper break-fast time for your location. One should take grains from offered prasādam in the right palm, face the sun, chant "Om Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya" three times, and then eat.
The puṇya from observing Ekādaśī may also be offered or shared with loved ones or ancestors by saying their names before eating the grains as described above.
